detail.longDescription: A story that begins in Kenya and ends with trust ( https:// marcusolang.substack.com/p/im- kenyan-i-dont-write-like-chatgpt ). 1. The Kenyan education system has extremely rigid views on English style and the composition of essays in English. 2. As a result, Kenyans have learned to write English in more or less the same style. 3. The final training of ChatGPT was done by Kenyans. 4. Therefore, ChatGPT writes English in the same, “Kenyan” style. 5. As a result of this, Kenyans who write in English on social media are accused of using ChatCPT for the composition of their texts. So, in another small way, a large language model destroyed trust in the Internet. # Kenya # ChatGPT # LargeLanguageModel # Trust
